full_name: IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation
organizer: IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS) - fully sponsored flagship conference

submission.type: full paper (no abstract-only stage); double-anonymous review; PaperPlaza
submission.typical_abstract_deadline: No separate abstract stage. Full paper deadline ~September 15 of the previous year (23:59 US Pacific), often extended by ~1 day (e.g. 2025: Sep 16, 2024; 2027: Sep 16, 2026).
submission.typical_final_deadline: Notification ~January 31; final (camera-ready) submission opens early February (Feb 6 for 2026/2027) with final papers due Feb-Mar (e.g. ICRA 2019: Feb 28, 2019; ICRA 2020: Mar 10, 2020).
submission.notes: abstract_deadline fields in this record hold the FULL PAPER submission deadline (ICRA has no abstract-only stage). Page limit: ICRA 2026 and 2027 = 8 pages total including references; ICRA 2025 = 6 pages + unlimited references; ICRA 2017-2020 = 6 pages (+2 paid extra pages). Review: 'double anonymous review process as defined by RAS' (ICRA 2027 / 2026 CFP). RA-L option: up to ICRA 2022 there was a separate 'RA-L with ICRA presentation option' submission with an earlier deadline (e.g. Sep 10, 2018 for ICRA 2019; Sep 10, 2019 for ICRA 2020; Oct 15, 2020 for ICRA 2021; Sep 9, 2021 for ICRA 2022). Current model (ICRA 2026/2027): no joint RA-L+ICRA submission; accepted papers from RAS journals (RA-L, RAM, T-RO, T-ASE, etc.) are automatically offered the option to present at a RAS conference after acceptance, with a journal-transfer deadline (Dec 31, 2026 for ICRA 2027). The exact year the old RA-L+ICRA option was discontinued was not verified (ccf-deadlines lists it for ICRA 2021-2022 but not 2023+).
